preguntas.pregunta: How many people attended Taylor Swift's 149 Eras Tour concerts in total?
pistas: She played almost always in football (soccer) stadiums.
A big stadium holds between 60,000 and 70,000 people per concert.
preguntas.explicacion: 149 concerts × about 68,000 people per night ≈ 10 million. Official figure: 10,168,008 tickets.
preguntas.curiosidad: It was the first tour in history to pass $2 billion in ticket sales: about $204 per person on average.
preguntas.fuente: Taylor Swift Touring, official figures published by The New York Times (December 2024)

preguntas.pregunta: How many copies of Minecraft had been sold worldwide by April 2025?
pistas: It is the best-selling video game of all time.
There are about 8 billion people in the world. One in how many has bought it?
preguntas.explicacion: If one in every 23 people on the planet has bought it: 8 billion / 23 ≈ 350 million. That is the figure Mojang confirmed in April 2025.
preguntas.curiosidad: In October 2023 it was 300 million: in a year and a half, another 50 million copies of a 2011 game were sold.
preguntas.fuente: Mojang Studios (April 2025)

preguntas.pregunta: How many stores does the Inditex group (the group that owns Zara, Bershka, Pull&Bear, Stradivarius…) have worldwide?
pistas: It is in almost 100 countries.
In most countries it has a few dozen stores; in a few, hundreds.
preguntas.explicacion: About 95 countries × about 55 stores on average ≈ 5,200. Official figure at the end of fiscal year 2025: 5,460.
preguntas.curiosidad: Every year it has fewer stores (103 fewer than the year before) and sells more: it closes small ones and opens huge ones.
preguntas.fuente: Inditex, fiscal year 2025 results (31 January 2026)

preguntas.pregunta: How many McDonald's restaurants were there in the world at the end of 2025?
pistas: It is in more than 100 countries.
The United States alone has 13,706: almost one in three.
preguntas.explicacion: If the 13,706 in the United States are a little under a third: 13,706 × 3.3 ≈ 45,000. Official figure on 31 December 2025: 45,356.
preguntas.curiosidad: In 2025 alone it opened about 2,300: more than six new restaurants every day.
preguntas.fuente: McDonald's Corporation, 2025 annual results

preguntas.pregunta: How many Starbucks coffee shops were there in the world in autumn 2025?
pistas: It is in 89 countries.
The United States and China together have about 25,000: six out of ten.
preguntas.explicacion: 25,000 coffee shops / 0.6 ≈ 41,000. Official figure at the end of its 2025 fiscal year: 40,990.
preguntas.curiosidad: A little under half are not run by Starbucks itself: other companies operate them under license.
preguntas.fuente: Starbucks Corporation, fiscal year 2025 annual report

preguntas.pregunta: How many visits did IKEA stores around the world receive in one year (fiscal year 2025)?
pistas: There are about 500 IKEA stores in the world.
About 5,000 people pass through each store every day.
preguntas.explicacion: 500 stores × 5,000 visits a day × 365 days ≈ 912 million. IKEA reported 915 million visits.
preguntas.curiosidad: It is as if one in nine people on the planet had been to an IKEA that year.
preguntas.fuente: IKEA (Inter IKEA Group), fiscal year 2025 annual summary

preguntas.pregunta: How many drinks from The Coca-Cola Company's brands are enjoyed around the world every day?
pistas: About 65 billion drinks of all kinds are consumed in the world every day.
A little over 3 in every 100 are from a Coca-Cola brand (Fanta, Sprite, Aquarius…).
preguntas.explicacion: 65 billion drinks × 0.034 ≈ 2.2 billion a day, the figure the company itself gives.
preguntas.curiosidad: That is one of the company's drinks for every four people on the planet, every day.
preguntas.fuente: The Coca-Cola Company, 2025 annual report

preguntas.pregunta: How many cars did Tesla deliver worldwide in 2025?
pistas: About 80 million new cars are sold in the world every year.
Two in every hundred are a Tesla.
preguntas.explicacion: 80 million cars × 0.02 = 1.6 million. Tesla's official figure: 1,636,129 deliveries.
preguntas.curiosidad: It was its second year in a row of decline, and China's BYD overtook it as the biggest seller of electric cars.
preguntas.fuente: Tesla, 2025 production and deliveries release

preguntas.pregunta: How many Apple Stores were there in the world in mid-2026?
pistas: There are stores in 27 countries; France has 20.
Half are in the United States: 269.
preguntas.explicacion: If the 269 in the United States are half, the total is 269 × 2 ≈ 540. Count in July 2026: 537 stores.
preguntas.curiosidad: Italy has 17 and Germany 16: all of Europe put together has far fewer than the United States.
preguntas.fuente: Count based on Apple's store directory (July 2026)

preguntas.pregunta: How many Nintendo Switch consoles (the original model) had been sold by September 2026?
pistas: It came out in 2017 and has been on sale for almost ten years.
About 16 million a year on average.
preguntas.explicacion: 9.5 years × 16.5 million a year ≈ 157 million. Nintendo's figure at 30 September 2026: 157.2 million.
preguntas.curiosidad: It has already passed the Nintendo DS (154 million), which was the company's best-selling console.
preguntas.fuente: Nintendo, cumulative console sales (30 September 2026)

preguntas.pregunta: How many Pokémon cards had been printed in all of history by March 2026?
pistas: Lately about 10 billion are printed a year.
The game has existed since 1996, but more than half of all cards are from the last six years.
preguntas.explicacion: The last six years at about 9 billion each make about 55 billion; the previous twenty-four years add another 30 billion. Total reported by The Pokémon Company: more than 85 billion.
preguntas.curiosidad: That is ten cards for every person on the planet.
preguntas.fuente: The Pokémon Company, trading card game figures as of 31 March 2026

preguntas.pregunta: How many Harry Potter books have been sold worldwide?
pistas: There are seven books, translated into 85 languages.
That works out at one book for every 13 or 14 people on the planet.
preguntas.explicacion: 8.1 billion people / 13.5 ≈ 600 million, the figure given by its publishers.
preguntas.curiosidad: When sales reached 500 million in 2018, the publisher estimated that one in 15 people in the world owned one.
preguntas.fuente: Scholastic and Bloomsbury, Harry Potter series sales figures (2023)

preguntas.pregunta: How many people did Amazon employ worldwide at the end of 2025?
pistas: Most do not work in offices, but in warehouses and deliveries.
That is as many as the people living in a city like Philadelphia.
preguntas.explicacion: Philadelphia has just over 1.6 million inhabitants, and that is the scale: Amazon reported 1,576,000 employees on 31 December 2025.
preguntas.curiosidad: It is the second-largest private employer in the world.
preguntas.fuente: Amazon, 2025 annual report

preguntas.pregunta: How many paid subscriptions did Netflix have at the end of 2025?
pistas: A subscription is usually for a whole household, not just one person.
Netflix estimates that almost a billion people watch it: about three per subscription.
preguntas.explicacion: 1 billion viewers / 3 people per subscription ≈ 330 million. Netflix reported more than 325 million.
preguntas.curiosidad: A year earlier it was 301 million: it gained 24 million households in twelve months.
preguntas.fuente: Netflix, fourth-quarter 2025 shareholder letter

preguntas.pregunta: How many people used Spotify every month in autumn 2026?
pistas: 306 million of them pay.
Fewer than four in ten pay; the rest listen for free with ads.
preguntas.explicacion: 306 million subscribers / 0.39 ≈ 785 million. Spotify's third-quarter 2026 figure: 788 million monthly users.
preguntas.curiosidad: Almost one in ten people on the planet uses it.
preguntas.fuente: Spotify, third-quarter 2026 results

preguntas.pregunta: How many articles did English Wikipedia have in November 2026?
pistas: Spanish Wikipedia has 2.1 million articles.
The English one is almost three and a half times bigger.
preguntas.explicacion: 2.1 million × 3.4 ≈ 7.2 million. Official counter on 12 November 2026: 7,263,198 articles.
preguntas.curiosidad: Together they add up to more than 5 billion words: reading them non-stop would take about forty years.
preguntas.fuente: English Wikipedia, official statistics (12 November 2026)

preguntas.pregunta: How many people played Roblox every day in summer 2026?
pistas: Most of its players are children and teenagers.
Roughly one in every 60 people on the planet plays every day.
preguntas.explicacion: 8.2 billion people / 60 ≈ 137 million. Roblox's third-quarter 2026 figure: 138 million daily players.
preguntas.curiosidad: Together they played almost 34 billion hours in just three months.
preguntas.fuente: Roblox Corporation, third-quarter 2026 results

preguntas.pregunta: How many visits did Disneyland Park in Paris receive in 2025 (not counting the resort's second park)?
pistas: It is open 365 days a year.
On average about 30,000 people come in each day.
preguntas.explicacion: 30,000 visitors a day × 365 days ≈ 10.9 million. Industry estimate for 2025: 10.8 million.
preguntas.curiosidad: It is the most visited theme park in Europe; the second, in Germany, receives a little over half as many.
preguntas.fuente: Themed Entertainment Association (TEA), Global Experience Index 2025

preguntas.pregunta: How many spectators went to the stadiums, adding up all the matches, at the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
pistas: 104 matches were played in the United States, Mexico and Canada.
The stadiums were huge: the average was about 65,000 spectators per match.
preguntas.explicacion: 104 matches × 65,000 spectators ≈ 6.8 million. Total recorded attendance: 6,810,966.
preguntas.curiosidad: That is double Qatar 2022, which drew 3.4 million spectators.
preguntas.fuente: Final statistics of the 2026 FIFA World Cup

preguntas.pregunta: How many athletes competed at the Paris 2024 Olympic Games?
pistas: 206 delegations took part.
There were 329 medal events; the average delegation brought about 50 athletes.
preguntas.explicacion: 206 delegations × 51 athletes on average ≈ 10,500, which was the quota set by the International Olympic Committee.
preguntas.curiosidad: It was the first Games with the same number of places for women as for men.
preguntas.fuente: International Olympic Committee, Paris 2024 Games

preguntas.pregunta: How many gold bears does Haribo make every day worldwide?
pistas: Each bear weighs a little over 2 grams: a 100-gram bag holds about 45.
Haribo sells in more than a hundred countries: think of several million bags a day.
preguntas.explicacion: If about 3.5 million 100-gram bags are filled each day with about 45 bears in each: 3.5 million × 45 ≈ 160 million. That is the figure Haribo itself gives.
preguntas.curiosidad: According to Haribo, the bears it makes in a year, lined up, would circle the Earth more than ten times.
preguntas.fuente: Haribo, corporate facts for the Goldbears centenary (2022)

preguntas.pregunta: How many trips and orders did Uber complete per day, on average, worldwide in summer 2026?
pistas: About 215 million people use Uber or Uber Eats every month.
Each uses it about six times a month on average.
preguntas.explicacion: 215 million users × 6 uses a month ≈ 1.3 billion a month, or about 44 million a day. Uber reported 4,061 million trips between July and September 2026: 4,061 / 92 days ≈ 44 million.
preguntas.curiosidad: Uber now moves almost as much money delivering food as carrying people.
preguntas.fuente: Uber, third-quarter 2026 results (calculation: trips in the quarter / 92 days)

preguntas.pregunta: How many dollars has Avatar (2009), the highest-grossing film in history, earned at cinemas worldwide?
pistas: A movie ticket, many of them for 3D, cost about $10.
Imagine that one in 25 people on the planet saw it in the cinema.
preguntas.explicacion: In 2009 there were about 7 billion people. If one in 25 went to see it, that is about 280 million tickets; at $10, about $2.8 billion. Actual total, including re-releases: $2,924 million.
preguntas.curiosidad: It cost $237 million to make: it earned more than twelve times its budget.
preguntas.fuente: Box Office Mojo, cumulative worldwide gross of Avatar (2009)

preguntas.pregunta: How many views did "Baby Shark Dance", YouTube's most-viewed video, have in February 2026?
pistas: It was the first YouTube video to pass 10 billion.
That works out at about two views for every person on the planet.
preguntas.explicacion: There are about 8.2 billion people in the world. Two views each: 16.4 billion. Guinness count on 4 February 2026: 16,643 million.
preguntas.curiosidad: The second most-viewed video, another children's song, does not reach 10 billion.
preguntas.fuente: Guinness World Records, most-viewed YouTube video (4 February 2026)

preguntas.pregunta: How many people watched the 2026 Eurovision Song Contest on television (adding the semi-finals and the final)?
pistas: Audiences are measured in 35 countries.
On average, about 4 million viewers per country.
preguntas.explicacion: 35 countries × about 3.7 million viewers on average ≈ 130 million. Figure from the European Broadcasting Union for the Vienna edition: 131 million.
preguntas.curiosidad: In 2025 it had been watched by 166 million people: in one year it lost 35 million viewers.
preguntas.fuente: European Broadcasting Union (EBU), Eurovision 2026 audience report

preguntas.pregunta: How many people watched the 2026 Super Bowl in the United States?
pistas: About 340 million people live in the United States.
A little over one in three Americans watches it.
preguntas.explicacion: 340 million inhabitants × 0.37 ≈ 126 million. Nielsen's final figure: 125.6 million viewers on average.
preguntas.curiosidad: The halftime show, with Bad Bunny, drew a bigger audience than the game itself: 128.2 million.
preguntas.fuente: Nielsen, final audience for Super Bowl LX (February 2026)

preguntas.pregunta: How many episodes of The Simpsons existed at the end of season 37, in 2026?
pistas: The show began in 1989 and has had one season a year.
Each season has about 22 episodes.
preguntas.explicacion: 37 seasons × 22 episodes ≈ 814. Actual count at the end of season 37: 809.
preguntas.curiosidad: Three different episodes can be counted as "number 800", depending on how you count.
preguntas.fuente: Official list of The Simpsons episodes (seasons 1 to 37)

preguntas.pregunta: How many Instagram followers did Cristiano Ronaldo have in November 2026?
pistas: He is the person with the most followers on Instagram in the world.
Roughly one in twelve people on the planet follows him.
preguntas.explicacion: 8.2 billion people / 12 ≈ 680 million. In November 2026 he had around 681 million followers.
preguntas.curiosidad: In May 2026 Instagram deleted fake accounts and Cristiano, Messi and Mbappé suddenly lost millions of followers.
preguntas.fuente: Instagram follower count published in November 2026 (Epidemic Sound)

preguntas.pregunta: How many runners finished the 2025 New York City Marathon?
pistas: It is one of the marathons with the most participants in the world.
Picture a big football (soccer) stadium, though not one of the biggest, filled with runners.
preguntas.explicacion: A big stadium holds around 60,000 seats, and that is the scale: in 2025, 59,226 runners crossed the finish line, a record for the race at the time.
preguntas.curiosidad: The record lasted a year: in 2026 more than 61,000 people finished.
preguntas.fuente: New York Road Runners, 2025 New York City Marathon results

preguntas.pregunta: How many kilometers was the official route of the 2026 Tour de France, which started in Barcelona?
pistas: The Tour has 21 stages.
A normal stage is around 160 kilometers; the time trials are much shorter.
preguntas.explicacion: 21 stages × 160 kilometers on average ≈ 3,360. The route presented for 2026 added up to about 3,333 kilometers.
preguntas.curiosidad: In the end less was raced: two stages were shortened and the riders covered about 3,245 kilometers.
preguntas.fuente: Official 2026 Tour de France route presented by the organizers (ASO)

preguntas.pregunta: How many goals were scored in total at the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
pistas: It was the first World Cup with 48 teams: 104 matches were played.
In a World Cup match almost three goals are scored on average.
preguntas.explicacion: 104 matches × 3 goals ≈ 312. Actual total: 308 goals, 2.96 per match.
preguntas.curiosidad: The previous record, the 172 goals of Qatar 2022, was equaled with 46 matches still to be played.
preguntas.fuente: Final statistics of the 2026 FIFA World Cup

preguntas.pregunta: How many different people had stood on the summit of Everest by the end of 2025?
pistas: The first time was in 1953, and until the 1990s very few people climbed it.
In a good spring about 850 people reach the summit, but many are guides who repeat year after year.
preguntas.explicacion: About 600 summits a year over the last two decades make about 13,000 ascents; since almost half are by repeat climbers, that leaves about 7,500 people. Count: 7,563 people and 13,737 ascents.
preguntas.curiosidad: Kami Rita Sherpa has been on the summit 31 times.
preguntas.fuente: The Himalayan Database, count up to December 2025 (compiled by Alan Arnette)

preguntas.pregunta: How many spectators attended the 2025 British Formula 1 Grand Prix, adding up all the days of the weekend?
pistas: Attendance is counted for every day: practice, qualifying and the race.
It is the grand prix with the biggest crowd of the year; on race day there are well over 100,000 people.
preguntas.explicacion: About 125,000 people on average over four days of activity at the circuit gives 500,000. It is Silverstone's official figure for 2025.
preguntas.curiosidad: To bring so many people it took 600 buses, which carried more than 125,000 people.
preguntas.fuente: Silverstone Circuit, official 2025 British Grand Prix figures

preguntas.pregunta: How many spectators fit in the world's largest cricket stadium, the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad (India)?
pistas: In India cricket is far more popular than football.
Melbourne's great stadium has about 100,000 seats, and this one is bigger.
preguntas.explicacion: Think of a 100,000-seat stadium and add a third more: its declared capacity is 132,000 spectators.
preguntas.curiosidad: It opened in 2020 on the site of another stadium, demolished five years earlier to build this one.
preguntas.fuente: International Cricket Council (ICC), Narendra Modi Stadium profile

preguntas.pregunta: How many commercial flights took off around the world every day, on average, in 2025?
pistas: Boeing 737s alone made 10.8 million flights over the whole year.
In all of 2025 there were about 38.9 million flights.
preguntas.explicacion: 38.9 million flights / 365 days ≈ 106,600 flights a day: more than one per second.
preguntas.curiosidad: In 2020, because of the pandemic, there were less than half as many: 16.9 million flights in the whole year.
preguntas.fuente: IATA, air transport outlook (December 2025); calculation: flights in the year / 365

preguntas.pregunta: How many floors does the Burj Khalifa in Dubai, the world's tallest building, have?
pistas: It is 828 meters tall, but the final spire has no floors.
The observation deck on floor 148 is 555 meters up.
preguntas.explicacion: 555 meters / 148 floors ≈ 3.75 meters per floor. Above the observation deck there are about fifteen more floors, almost all technical: 163 in total.
preguntas.curiosidad: Climbing the stairs to floor 160 is 2,909 steps.
preguntas.fuente: Guinness World Records and the Burj Khalifa fact sheet (Emaar)

preguntas.pregunta: How many steps are there from the ground to the very top of the Eiffel Tower?
pistas: The staircase goes up to about 280 meters.
A normal step rises about 17 centimeters.
preguntas.explicacion: 280 meters / 0.17 meters per step ≈ 1,650. Official figure: 1,665 steps.
preguntas.curiosidad: The public can only walk up to the second floor; from there to the top, it is by elevator.
preguntas.fuente: Société d'Exploitation de la Tour Eiffel, press kit (2024)

preguntas.pregunta: How many ships crossed the Panama Canal in its 2025 fiscal year (October 2024 to September 2025)?
pistas: The canal works day and night, every day of the year.
Between 35 and 40 ships cross it every day.
preguntas.explicacion: 37 ships a day × 365 days ≈ 13,500. Figure from the Canal Authority: 13,404 transits.
preguntas.curiosidad: The year before, because of drought, only 11,240 could pass: the canal needs fresh water to fill its locks.
preguntas.fuente: Panama Canal Authority, fiscal year 2025 results

preguntas.pregunta: How many standard 6-meter containers fit on the world's largest container ship?
pistas: The ship is 400 meters long and about 60 wide.
The containers go in 24 rows across and are stacked about 20 high between the hold and the deck.
preguntas.explicacion: Along the length about 48 containers fit (the rest is engines and the bridge), across 24, and they are stacked about 21 high: 48 × 24 × 21 ≈ 24,000. Certified capacity: 24,346.
preguntas.curiosidad: It is not one ship but several sister ships of the shipping line MSC that share the record with exactly the same capacity.
preguntas.fuente: Register of the largest container ships (MSC Irina class, 24,346 TEU)

preguntas.pregunta: How many passengers can the world's largest cruise ship carry at most?
pistas: The crew alone is 2,350 people.
With two people per cabin it carries 5,610 passengers; the maximum capacity also counts sofa beds and bunks.
preguntas.explicacion: About 2,800 cabins × 2 people = 5,610. With the extra beds in family cabins, a third more: 7,600 passengers at most.
preguntas.curiosidad: With the crew included, nearly 10,000 people travel on board: more than the population of many towns.
preguntas.fuente: Royal Caribbean, maximum capacity of Icon of the Seas and Star of the Seas

preguntas.pregunta: How many buses are in London's red bus network?
pistas: About 9 million people live in London.
That works out at roughly one bus for every thousand inhabitants.
preguntas.explicacion: 9 million inhabitants / 1,000 ≈ 9,000. Fleet count at 31 March 2025: 8,797 buses.
preguntas.curiosidad: In 2016 only about 30 were electric; by 2026 there were 3,000, a third of the fleet.
preguntas.fuente: Transport for London, bus fleet audit (31 March 2025)

preguntas.pregunta: How many drink vending machines were there in Japan at the end of 2023?
pistas: About 124 million people live in Japan.
There is one drink machine for every 55 people or so.
preguntas.explicacion: 124 million inhabitants / 55 ≈ 2.25 million. Count by the industry association: 2,218,600 drink machines.
preguntas.curiosidad: Counting those for food, tickets, cigarettes and so on as well, Japan has almost 4 million vending machines.
preguntas.fuente: Japan Vending Machine Manufacturers Association (JVMA), data from the end of 2023

preguntas.pregunta: How many people visited the Louvre in Paris in 2025?
pistas: The museum is closed on Tuesdays.
It limits entry to about 30,000 people a day.
preguntas.explicacion: About 310 opening days × 29,000 visitors a day ≈ 9 million, which is the figure the museum gave for 2025.
preguntas.curiosidad: Almost half of the visitors, 44%, were under 26.
preguntas.fuente: Louvre Museum, 2025 visitor report

preguntas.pregunta: How many stations does the New York City subway have?
pistas: The London Underground has about 270 stations.
New York's is the subway with the most stations in the world, but it does not reach 500.
preguntas.explicacion: The London Underground has 272 stations, and New York's network is larger: about 1.7 times as many is roughly 460. Official figure: 472.
preguntas.curiosidad: If stations linked by transfer passages are counted as one, it comes to 424.
preguntas.fuente: Metropolitan Transportation Authority (MTA), New York

preguntas.pregunta: How many people visited the Colosseum in Rome in 2024 (together with the Roman Forum and the Palatine Hill, which share a ticket)?
pistas: It is open almost every day of the year.
On average about 40,000 people come in each day.
preguntas.explicacion: 40,000 visitors a day × 365 days ≈ 14.6 million. Official 2024 figure: 14,733,395.
preguntas.curiosidad: That year it took in more than 100 million euros in ticket sales for the first time.
preguntas.fuente: Italian Ministry of Culture, 2024 museum statistics

preguntas.pregunta: How many hotel rooms are there in Las Vegas?
pistas: The city receives about 38.5 million visitors a year.
They stay two or three nights, almost always two people per room, and hotels are 80% full.
preguntas.explicacion: 38.5 million visitors × 2.3 nights / 2 people per room ≈ 44 million room-nights. Divided over 365 days and with 80% occupancy: about 151,000 rooms. Official figure: 150,300.
preguntas.curiosidad: It is the city with the most hotel rooms in the United States and the second in the world.
preguntas.fuente: Las Vegas Convention and Visitors Authority (LVCVA), 2025 summary

preguntas.pregunta: Roughly how many trees are there in Central Park (New York)?
pistas: The park covers 341 hectares: about 3.4 million square meters.
Between lawns, lakes and paths, that works out at one tree for every 190 square meters.
preguntas.explicacion: 3.4 million square meters, at one tree for every 190: about 18,000, the figure given by the organization that looks after the park.
preguntas.curiosidad: It holds one of the largest groves of American elms left in the world.
preguntas.fuente: Central Park Conservancy, Central Park tree guide

preguntas.pregunta: How many eggs did each laying hen on US farms lay on average in 2025?
pistas: A hen cannot lay more than one egg a day.
At her best she lays about six a week, but she also has weeks off.
preguntas.explicacion: If she laid one a day it would be 365. With rest days, she lays on four out of five days: 365 × 0.8 ≈ 290. Official 2025 average: 288 eggs per hen.
preguntas.curiosidad: Together they laid about 105 billion eggs in a year: more than 300 for every American.
preguntas.fuente: US Department of Agriculture (USDA), 2025 annual chickens and eggs summary

preguntas.pregunta: How many kilos of chocolate did the average person in Switzerland eat in 2025?
pistas: A normal bar weighs 100 grams.
That works out at two bars a week.
preguntas.explicacion: 2 bars a week × 52 weeks = 104 bars of 100 grams: 10.4 kilos. Swiss manufacturers' figure for 2025: 10.3 kilos per person.
preguntas.curiosidad: Almost half of that chocolate (4.2 kilos) is imported: even the Swiss do not eat only Swiss chocolate.
preguntas.fuente: Chocosuisse, 2025 annual report

preguntas.pregunta: How many restaurants in the world had three Michelin stars in September 2026?
pistas: France has 30 and Japan, 20.
Spain has 16, and there are three-star restaurants in 25 countries.
preguntas.explicacion: The five countries with the most (France, Japan, Spain, the United States and Italy) add up to 97. The other twenty countries have about three each on average: 65 more. In total, 162.
preguntas.curiosidad: That is less than 1% of the nearly 20,000 restaurants in the guide.
preguntas.fuente: Michelin Guide, count of three-star restaurants (24 September 2026)

preguntas.pregunta: According to China's latest official census, how many giant pandas live in the wild?
pistas: They live only in the bamboo forests of the mountains of central China.
Their national park covers 22,000 square kilometers and almost three in four live there.
preguntas.explicacion: A panda needs a lot of forest: at one per 16 square kilometers, the park holds about 1,375, which is 72% of the total. 1,375 / 0.72 ≈ 1,900. Official census: 1,864.
preguntas.curiosidad: In captivity there are already 808 in China alone, almost double what there were ten years ago.
preguntas.fuente: Fourth National Giant Panda Survey (China), reported by WWF and the IUCN

preguntas.pregunta: How many tigers live in the wild worldwide, according to the latest international estimate (2023)?
pistas: In 2010 about 3,200 were left.
Two in three live in India, which counted 3,682 in its latest census.
preguntas.explicacion: If India's 3,682 tigers are two thirds of the total, the total is 3,682 × 1.5 ≈ 5,500. Global Tiger Forum estimate: 5,574.
preguntas.curiosidad: In 2010 the tiger countries set out to double their number in twelve years. They came close, but did not make it.
preguntas.fuente: Global Tiger Forum, 2023 global estimate (published by WWF)

preguntas.pregunta: How many dog breeds does the Fédération Cynologique Internationale (FCI) recognize?
pistas: It divides them into 10 groups: sheepdogs, terriers, hounds, sighthounds, companion dogs…
Each group has about 36 breeds on average.
preguntas.explicacion: 10 groups × 36 breeds on average ≈ 360. Official FCI count in 2026: 364 breeds.
preguntas.curiosidad: Each breed has an "owner" country, usually its country of origin, which decides what the perfect dog of that breed should be like.
preguntas.fuente: Fédération Cynologique Internationale (FCI), official nomenclature (2026)

preguntas.pregunta: How many sheep were there in New Zealand in 2025?
pistas: A little over 5 million people live in New Zealand.
There are more than four sheep for every inhabitant.
preguntas.explicacion: 5.3 million inhabitants × 4.4 sheep per person ≈ 23 million. Official count in June 2025: 23,252,463.
preguntas.curiosidad: Every year there are fewer: in two years the flock lost more than a million sheep, mainly because pasture is being turned into forest.
preguntas.fuente: Stats NZ, 2025 agricultural production statistics

preguntas.pregunta: How many roller coasters are there in the world, according to the census kept by enthusiasts?
pistas: More than half are in Asia.
Europe has about 1,600 and North America about 1,000.
preguntas.explicacion: Europe (1,600) and North America (1,000) add up to 2,600; the rest of the world without Asia, about 400. If Asia has a little over half of the total, that is about 3,300: about 6,300 in all. Census: 6,324.
preguntas.curiosidad: Only 170 are wooden; all the others are steel.
preguntas.fuente: Roller Coaster DataBase (RCDB), census consulted in November 2026

preguntas.pregunta: How many working satellites were in orbit around the Earth in October 2026?
pistas: Two in three belong to a single network: Starlink.
Starlink has about 11,000 satellites working.
preguntas.explicacion: If Starlink's 11,000 are two thirds of the total, the total is 11,000 × 1.5 ≈ 16,500. The October 2026 catalogs count about 16,800 active satellites.
preguntas.curiosidad: Only seven years ago, before Starlink, there were about 2,000 in total.
preguntas.fuente: KeepTrack and CelesTrak satellite catalogs (October 2026)

preguntas.pregunta: How many emojis are there in total in the 2026 version of the Unicode standard, counting skin tone and gender variants?
pistas: Without variants there are about 1,400 basic emojis.
There are 259 flags alone, and many emojis of people come in five skin tones.
preguntas.explicacion: To the 1,400 basic emojis you have to add the variants: about 500 emojis of people and hands × 5 skin tones is about 2,500 more. In total, 3,972.
preguntas.curiosidad: The 2026 version adds only nine new emojis, among them a pickle, a lighthouse and a meteorite.
preguntas.fuente: Unicode Consortium, Emoji 18.0 count (September 2026)

preguntas.pregunta: How many living languages are there in the world, according to the 2026 Ethnologue catalog?
pistas: There are about 195 countries, but in many of them dozens or hundreds of languages are spoken.
That works out at about 37 languages per country on average.
preguntas.explicacion: 195 countries × 37 languages on average ≈ 7,200. The 2026 edition of Ethnologue counts 7,170 living languages.
preguntas.curiosidad: The number changes with every edition: some languages die out and others are "discovered" when two dialects are judged to be different languages.
preguntas.fuente: Ethnologue, 29th edition (2026)

preguntas.pregunta: How many undersea internet cables were in service in the world in 2026?
pistas: Almost all internet traffic between continents travels along the seabed.
Together they total close to a million and a half kilometers; an average cable is about 2,500 long.
preguntas.explicacion: 1.5 million kilometers / 2,500 kilometers per cable ≈ 600. Count in September 2026: 607 cables in service.
preguntas.curiosidad: Another 102 are already planned: a new cable is laid every few weeks.
preguntas.fuente: TeleGeography, submarine cable map (September 2026)

preguntas.pregunta: How many electric and plug-in hybrid cars were sold in the world in 2025?
pistas: About 80 million new cars are sold in the world every year.
One in four new cars is now electric or plug-in.
preguntas.explicacion: 80 million new cars / 4 = 20 million, the figure given by the International Energy Agency for 2025.
preguntas.curiosidad: In China they are already more than half of new cars: almost 55%.
preguntas.fuente: International Energy Agency (IEA), Global EV Outlook 2026

preguntas.pregunta: According to Apple, how many apps are available on the App Store?
pistas: When it opened, in 2008, it had 500 apps.
Today it is about 4,000 times bigger.
preguntas.explicacion: 500 apps × 4,000 = 2 million. Apple talks of "almost two million" apps.
preguntas.curiosidad: In the first half of 2026 alone about 560,000 new apps were published, almost as many as in all of 2025.
preguntas.fuente: Apple, official App Store data (2026)

preguntas.pregunta: How many euro banknotes were in circulation in 2026?
pistas: About 350 million people live in the euro countries.
That works out at about 90 banknotes per person: many are kept at home, in banks or outside Europe.
preguntas.explicacion: 350 million people × 90 banknotes ≈ 31.5 billion. European Central Bank figure for April 2026: 31.3 billion banknotes.
preguntas.curiosidad: Together they are worth more than 1.6 trillion euros: the average banknote is about 50 euros.
preguntas.fuente: European Central Bank, banknotes in circulation (April 2026)

preguntas.pregunta: How many different people received a Nobel Prize between 1901 and 2025?
pistas: In that time 633 prizes were awarded, adding up the six categories.
Many prizes are shared between two or three people.
preguntas.explicacion: 633 prizes × 1.6 people per prize ≈ 1,000. Nobel Foundation count: 990 people, plus 28 organizations.
preguntas.curiosidad: With the 2026 prizes it is already 996: the thousandth laureate is just around the corner.
preguntas.fuente: Nobel Foundation (nobelprize.org), count of prizes and laureates 1901-2025

preguntas.pregunta: How many items (books, maps, photos, sheet music, manuscripts…) does the Library of Congress in the United States, the largest library in the world, hold?
pistas: Books are only part of it: it also holds photos, maps, records, films and manuscripts.
It was founded in 1800 and receives thousands of new items every day.
preguntas.explicacion: If since 1800 it had taken in about 2,200 items a day: 2,200 × 365 days × 225 years ≈ 181 million, which is what it reports today.
preguntas.curiosidad: It started with 740 books and three maps.
preguntas.fuente: Library of Congress, fiscal year 2025 report

preguntas.pregunta: How many pipes does the great organ of Notre-Dame Cathedral in Paris have?
pistas: Each note of each different sound (each "stop") needs its own pipe.
It has 117 stops and keyboards of about 60 notes.
preguntas.explicacion: 117 stops × 60 notes ≈ 7,000 pipes, and some stops use several pipes per note. Official cathedral figure: 7,952.
preguntas.curiosidad: It survived the 2019 fire, but it had to be taken apart completely to clean the lead dust off every pipe.
preguntas.fuente: Notre-Dame Cathedral of Paris, official data on the great organ

preguntas.pregunta: How many stone blocks are estimated to make up the Great Pyramid of Giza?
pistas: The base is 230 meters on each side and the pyramid was 146 meters tall.
Each block takes up a little over a cubic meter.
preguntas.explicacion: Volume of a pyramid: base × height / 3 = 230 × 230 × 146 / 3 ≈ 2.6 million cubic meters. At 1.1 cubic meters per block, about 2.3 million, the usual estimate.
preguntas.curiosidad: An average block weighs two and a half tonnes, as much as two cars.
preguntas.fuente: Usual archaeological estimate (Encyclopaedia Britannica and other reference works)

preguntas.pregunta: How many people were aboard the Titanic when it sank?
pistas: The lifeboats had room for only 1,178.
About 705 people survived, fewer than a third.
preguntas.explicacion: If 705 survivors were a little under a third, there were 705 × 3.15 ≈ 2,220 aboard. The most quoted figure is 2,224 people, passengers and crew together.
preguntas.curiosidad: The boats were not even full: there was room for 1,178 people and about 705 were saved.
preguntas.fuente: Encyclopaedia Britannica (based on the 1912 US Senate inquiry)

preguntas.pregunta: How many terracotta warriors are estimated to be buried in the mausoleum of China's first emperor, in Xi'an?
pistas: It is a complete, life-size army to protect the emperor in the afterlife.
So far only a quarter has been unearthed: about 2,000 figures.
preguntas.explicacion: If the 2,000 excavated figures are a quarter, the total is around 2,000 × 4 = 8,000, which is the museum's estimate.
preguntas.curiosidad: No two faces are alike: each soldier has his own features.
preguntas.fuente: Museum of the Mausoleum of Emperor Qin Shi Huang (Xi'an), official estimate

preguntas.pregunta: How many children write to Santa Claus each Christmas through the French postal service?
pistas: About 650,000 children are born in France every year.
Roughly the children aged 4 to 9 write, but only one in four.
preguntas.explicacion: Six age groups × 650,000 children ≈ 4 million children of writing age. One in four is a million, the figure the French post office gives every year.
preguntas.curiosidad: Every letter gets a reply: it is written by 60 postal "elves" in a village near Bordeaux.
preguntas.fuente: La Poste, Santa's secretariat (2025 campaign)

preguntas.pregunta: How many lights does the Christmas tree at Rockefeller Center in New York have?
pistas: The tree is about 23 meters tall.
The lights run along about 8 kilometers of cable: one every 16 centimeters.
preguntas.explicacion: 8 kilometers is 8,000 meters of cable. With one light every 16 centimeters: 8,000 / 0.16 = 50,000 lights.
preguntas.curiosidad: The star on top weighs about 400 kilos and has three million crystals.
preguntas.fuente: Rockefeller Center, official facts about the 2025 Christmas tree

preguntas.pregunta: How many people watched the 2022 World Cup final between Argentina and France on television?
pistas: There were about 8 billion people in the world.
More than one in six watched, at least for a while.
preguntas.explicacion: 8 billion people / 5.6 ≈ 1.43 billion. FIFA's revised figure: 1.42 billion viewers.
preguntas.curiosidad: The 2026 final, which Spain won against Argentina in extra time, was the most-watched in United States history: 62.8 million.
preguntas.fuente: FIFA, global audience report (November 2024)

preguntas.pregunta: How many stations does the London Underground have?
pistas: The network has 11 lines.
Each line stops at about 35 stations, but many stations are shared by two or more lines.
preguntas.explicacion: 11 lines × 35 stops ≈ 385. Take away the interchange stations that would be counted twice or more, and about 270 are left. Official count: 272.
preguntas.curiosidad: Despite the name, less than half of the Underground actually runs in tunnels.
preguntas.fuente: Transport for London, station count (2026)

preguntas.pregunta: How many yellow taxi licenses (medallions) are there in New York City?
pistas: More than 8 million people live in New York City.
That works out at one yellow cab for roughly every 620 people.
preguntas.explicacion: 8.4 million people / 620 ≈ 13,500. The number of medallions is capped by law at 13,587.
preguntas.curiosidad: Not all of them are on the road: in 2025 only about 10,400 yellow cabs were actually working.
preguntas.fuente: New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission, medallion cap

preguntas.pregunta: How many passengers used London Heathrow Airport in 2025?
pistas: On its busiest day ever, just over 270,000 passengers passed through.
An average day sees about 230,000.
preguntas.explicacion: 230,000 passengers a day × 365 days ≈ 84 million. Official total for 2025: 84.46 million.
preguntas.curiosidad: It stayed Europe's busiest airport by a hair: Istanbul finished the year with 84.44 million.
preguntas.fuente: Heathrow Airport, traffic figures for 2025

preguntas.pregunta: How many Costco warehouses were there worldwide in August 2026?
pistas: Costco operates in 14 countries and territories.
The United States has 647 of them: a bit over two thirds.
preguntas.explicacion: If the 647 in the United States are a little over two thirds of the total, the total is 647 / 0.69 ≈ 940. Costco's annual report: 939.
preguntas.curiosidad: It grows slowly on purpose: only 28 warehouses opened in the whole year.
preguntas.fuente: Costco Wholesale, annual report for fiscal year 2026

preguntas.pregunta: How many Walmart stores are there in the United States, not counting Sam's Club?
pistas: About 340 million people live in the United States.
There is roughly one Walmart for every 74,000 Americans.
preguntas.explicacion: 340 million people / 74,000 ≈ 4,600. Walmart's own count in July 2026: 4,615 stores.
preguntas.curiosidad: More than three in four are Supercenters, the giant ones that also sell groceries.
preguntas.fuente: Walmart Inc., store counts (July 2026)

preguntas.pregunta: How many visits did US national parks record in 2025?
pistas: About 340 million people live in the United States.
It comes to almost one visit per American, although many people go several times and many visitors are tourists.
preguntas.explicacion: 340 million people × a bit under one visit each ≈ 320 million. National Park Service count for 2025: 323 million visits.
preguntas.curiosidad: The most visited site is not a park but a road: the Blue Ridge Parkway, with 16.5 million visits.
preguntas.fuente: US National Park Service, annual visitation for 2025

preguntas.pregunta: How many goals were scored in the 2025-26 Premier League season?
pistas: Twenty teams each play 38 matches: 380 matches in all.
An average match has between two and three goals.
preguntas.explicacion: 380 matches × 2.75 goals ≈ 1,045, which is exactly the season's total.
preguntas.curiosidad: The record is 1,084 goals, set in the 2022-23 season.
preguntas.fuente: Premier League, 2025-26 season statistics

preguntas.pregunta: How many runners finished the 2026 London Marathon?
pistas: It set a world record for the most finishers in a marathon.
Picture Wembley Stadium two thirds full of runners.
preguntas.explicacion: Wembley holds 90,000 people; two thirds of that is 60,000. Official count: 59,830 finishers.
preguntas.curiosidad: The record did not last the year: the New York City Marathon passed it that November.
preguntas.fuente: London Marathon Events and Guinness World Records (April 2026)

preguntas.pregunta: How many tickets were used to see Broadway shows in the 2025-26 season?
pistas: Broadway has 41 theaters.
A typical one has about 1,200 seats and plays eight shows a week, but not every theater is open all year.
preguntas.explicacion: 41 theaters × 1,200 seats × 8 shows × 52 weeks ≈ 20 million seats if every theater were open all year. About three quarters of that were filled: 14.6 million.
preguntas.curiosidad: Those tickets brought in a record $1.91 billion: about $131 each.
preguntas.fuente: The Broadway League, 2025-26 season results

preguntas.pregunta: How many pubs were there in the United Kingdom in 2025?
pistas: About 69 million people live in the United Kingdom.
That is one pub for roughly every 1,500 people.
preguntas.explicacion: 69 million people / 1,500 ≈ 46,000. The industry's count for 2025: 44,656 pubs.
preguntas.curiosidad: There are fewer every year: in early 2026 nearly two pubs closed every day.
preguntas.fuente: British Beer and Pub Association (2025)

preguntas.pregunta: How many steps are there from street level to the 102nd floor of the Empire State Building?
pistas: The climb covers 102 floors.
A typical floor needs about 18 steps.
preguntas.explicacion: 102 floors × 18 steps ≈ 1,840. Official figure: 1,860 steps.
preguntas.curiosidad: Every year there is a race up the stairs to the 86th floor: 1,576 steps.
preguntas.fuente: Empire State Building, official facts and figures

preguntas.pregunta: How many vehicles cross the Golden Gate Bridge on an average day?
pistas: It has six lanes and is open around the clock.
About 34 million vehicles cross it in a year.
preguntas.explicacion: 34.3 million crossings in a year / 365 days ≈ 94,000 a day: more than one every second.
preguntas.curiosidad: Before the pandemic it carried about 40 million a year; traffic never fully came back.
preguntas.fuente: Golden Gate Bridge, Highway and Transportation District, crossings for fiscal year 2026 (yearly total / 365)

preguntas.pregunta: How many shops did Greggs, the British bakery chain, have at the end of 2025?
pistas: About 69 million people live in the United Kingdom.
There is one Greggs for roughly every 25,000 people.
preguntas.explicacion: 69 million people / 25,000 ≈ 2,760. Greggs reported 2,739 shops at the end of 2025.
preguntas.curiosidad: It opened about four new shops every week of the year.
preguntas.fuente: Greggs plc, results for 2025

preguntas.pregunta: How many passengers travel on India's railways on an average day?
pistas: More than 1.4 billion people live in India.
On a typical day about one person in 70 takes a train.
preguntas.explicacion: 1.42 billion people / 70 ≈ 20 million. Indian Railways carried about 7,300 million passengers in a year: 20 million a day.
preguntas.curiosidad: Nearly nine in ten travel without a reserved seat.
preguntas.fuente: Indian Ministry of Railways, passengers in 2024-25 (yearly total / 365)

preguntas.pregunta: How many Subway restaurants are there in the world?
pistas: Subway is in more than 100 countries.
About half are in the United States: 18,773.
preguntas.explicacion: If the 18,773 in the United States are about half, the total is roughly 37,500. Subway says it has nearly 37,000 restaurants.
preguntas.curiosidad: It has been shrinking at home for ten years in a row: 729 US restaurants closed in 2025 alone.
preguntas.fuente: Subway, company figures (2025)

preguntas.pregunta: How many post offices does the US Postal Service run?
pistas: About 340 million people live in the United States.
There is one post office for roughly every 11,000 people.
preguntas.explicacion: 340 million people / 11,000 ≈ 31,000. The Postal Service counts 31,132 post offices of its own.
preguntas.curiosidad: The number has barely moved in more than a decade: in 2012 there were 31,509.
preguntas.fuente: US Postal Service, Postal Facts

preguntas.pregunta: How many people attended Wimbledon in 2026, adding up all the days of the tournament?
pistas: The tournament lasts 14 days.
About 39,000 people come through the gates each day.
preguntas.explicacion: 14 days × 39,000 people ≈ 550,000. Official attendance: 550,151.
preguntas.curiosidad: It was the first Wimbledon without a single rain delay since 2019.
preguntas.fuente: All England Lawn Tennis Club, attendance for the 2026 Championships

preguntas.pregunta: How many people visited the British Museum in London in 2025?
pistas: Entry is free and it opens almost every day of the year.
Close to 18,000 people walk in on an average day.
preguntas.explicacion: 17,800 visitors a day × 362 open days ≈ 6.4 million. Official figure for 2025: 6,440,120.
preguntas.curiosidad: After years as the UK's most visited attraction, it lost the top spot in 2025 to the Natural History Museum.
preguntas.fuente: Association of Leading Visitor Attractions (ALVA), visitor figures for 2025

preguntas.pregunta: What was the average crowd at an NFL regular-season game in 2025?
pistas: NFL stadiums hold between about 60,000 and 82,000 people.
Nearly every game sells out.
preguntas.explicacion: With stadiums between 60,000 and 82,000 seats and almost all of them full, the average lands near 70,000. Reported average for 2025: 69,055.
preguntas.curiosidad: Games played abroad drew almost exactly the same: 68,763 on average.
preguntas.fuente: Sports Business Journal, NFL attendance for the 2025 season
